name: Organic alien comb texture: sub-audio saw click train → high-resonance filter → very short, high-feedback delay played by hand
goal: Make an organic alien/sci-fi comb texture bed on most subtractive synths: pitch one saw all the way down until individual saw teeth are heard as a click train, run it through one low-pass at 80–100% resonance, then a delay at full mix with very short time and very long feedback (a comb resonator), adding optional comb filter, moderate pitch modulation and reverb — and perform delay time and cutoff manually (MIDI CC) rather than with modulation for an organic result. Distinct from formant/comb pad recipes that use a dedicated comb filter on sustained oscillators.

source.title: Organic Alien Comb Filter Modulation Tutorial (Subtractive Synthesis)

prerequisites: Subtractive synth with filter resonance and delay effect (time + feedback)
Hardware knobs or a MIDI controller with MIDI-learn

inputs.name: controller_map
inputs.description: CC knobs for cutoff, delay time, FX

constraints: Original synthesis recipe; not affiliated with any vendor named in the source. Recreate in browser/Web Audio (Polyrhythm Studio) or any hybrid synth with comparable modules; no presets, banks or samples copied.
High resonance + high delay feedback can run away; ride levels while performing.
Web Audio note (implementation, not from transcript): a DelayNode inside a feedback loop is limited to ≥128 samples; for very short comb times use an AudioWorklet delay.

steps.action: Init the patch. Use oscillator 1 only (osc balance fully to osc 1) with a saw.
Turn the semitone/coarse knob all the way down until the saw becomes a click train where each tooth spike is audible.
steps.expect: Rhythmic clicks instead of a pitched tone

steps.action: Use filter 1 only; lower the cutoff a notch and raise resonance to about 80–100%.
steps.expect: Each click rings at the resonant frequency

steps.action: Turn the delay mix all the way up, choose a very short delay time and very long feedback.
steps.expect: Clicks smear into a pitched, comb-like metallic resonance

steps.action: Play with the delay time while sounds are running to sweep the comb pitch.
steps.expect: Alien pitch slides and resonance shifts

steps.action: Optional variations: add the synth's comb filter mode; add pitch modulation at a moderate speed.
Reduce the delay slightly and add a little reverb on top.
Do not modulate the filter: map cutoff (and FX parameters) to a MIDI controller via MIDI-learn and move them by hand while recording, changing timbre continuously.
steps.expect: Organic, performed evolution captured in the recording

verification: At step 2 individual clicks are audible.
After delay step the texture has a clear comb/metallic pitch that moves with delay time.
Recording shows manual cutoff/delay movement (no static loop).
